panels.rationale: Spiral abdominopelvic CT from a case report whose title is disease-focused (MEN2B with gangliomatosis of the gastrointestinal tract). The caption describes small-bowel wall thickening — the radiological correlate of this patient's intestinal ganglioneuromatosis, a core MEN2B manifestation — and multiple calcified/noncalcified hepatic lesions suggestive of metastasis from medullary thyroid carcinoma, plus an anterior abdominal wall fistula, hydronephrosis, ascites and pleural effusion. This is a real patient radiology image, not a diagram, not third-party. MEN2B attribution is supported by the disease-focused article title together with the captioned bowel manifestation; the hepatic lesions are a complication of the disease's medullary thyroid carcinoma component and the shown slices are upper-abdominal, so confidence is moderate rather than high.
